name: Cheerful Tune

source.title: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose

disable: DC 20 Religion check (trained) to exorcise the spirits, or DC 21 Intimidation check to convince the spirits it is time to take a break; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
reset: The ghostly workers cease their routine 2 rounds after all living creatures leave the room and reset after 6 hours.
routine: (3 actions) Ghostly workers appear in the room and begin abrading, scrubbing, and splashing cleaning chemicals on anyone in the area. Each creature in the room takes 1d4+2 slashing and 1d4+2 acid damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save; roll once for both).

items.name: Nose to the Grindstone
items.text:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the smiling face in the center of the north wall

---

Effect The whistling rises in volume to a painful pitch and deals 1d8+4 sonic damage. The affected creature must attempt a DC 20 Will save save, and the haunt then rolls initiative.

---

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Deafened for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Frightened 1, and is deafened for 2 minutes.

text: A cheerful, wordless tune fills the room, compelling everyone to get to work.
